c9a891f6-9f4b-487d-8b62-7abb0e3f59c8.title: Under the Oak Tree
c9a891f6-9f4b-487d-8b62-7abb0e3f59c8.description:
The daughter of a duke, the stuttering Maximilian, married a knight of lowly status at her father’s coercion. After their first night, her husband departed for an expedition without another word. He came back three years later, this time as a famous knight in the whole continent. How will Maximilian face him on his return?

"The more I think of you, the more lonely and lonely I become. I don't know why I can't quit even though it's so painful."

---
A flawless love story of the flawed. Stuttering lady Maximilian is forced into a marriage with Sir Riftan, but he leaves on a campaign after their wedding night. Three years later, he triumphantly returns, ready to cherish her. As life with her husband finally begins, she only has one question — does she deserve this love and happiness?

---

5184157d-d579-4621-ad60-79164d756683.title: Cheonma Gaekjan
5184157d-d579-4621-ad60-79164d756683.description:
One day, Joo Kang-hyun, a stranger who fell into the world of martial arts, rose to the position of Heavenly Demon after going through countless hardships. However, he always missed his hometown, the 21st-century Republic of Korea. He thought he would return to his hometown once the proper array was activated, but instead, he regressed to the past.

Gosh… The Heavenly Demon, Joo Kang-hyun, went back in time! In order to save the Youngrae Tavern which was on the verge of bankruptcy, he cooked delicious Jajangmyeon and Jjamppong! This tavern was the place where he lived with the three siblings who took care of him when he first entered Murim, Soran, Doran, and Unyoung. Although their business was not going well, they lived happily in their own way. In the future, after he became The Heavenly Demon, he heard news that their lives all ended miserably. He planned to stop their misfortunes himself. How? With Future Vision, Demon Lord Qi and Jajangmyeon!

*Jinbeob : This is a term in the murim world that means 'formation/array' which in some cases refers to the formations used by soldiers or groups of people in battle, but in some cases it also refers to formations used to distort space in order to manipulate the opponent's mind and make the opponent fall into the illusion desired by the attacker, we can also call it a 'hidden space'

babfe681-136b-4328-a77d-d4425da42c75.title: My Fake Love
babfe681-136b-4328-a77d-d4425da42c75.description:
A high school girl, Rai, secretly has a crush on her childhood friend, Do-gyeong.
To hide her feelings, she pretends to be an idol fan.

Just when she couldn't give up on either her one-sided love or her fangirling—her favorite idol transfers to her school?!
With Neulchan’s transfer, the relationship that seemed unchangeable begins to shake.

"We're just friends, so why are you jealous?"

A summer-lit school romance about a childhood friend turning into a girlfriend!

e40f4e91-ab86-4448-8d03-78332d481455.title: Inu mo Arukeba Hime ni Ataru
e40f4e91-ab86-4448-8d03-78332d481455.altTitle: Even a Dog Might Stumble Upon a Princess
e40f4e91-ab86-4448-8d03-78332d481455.description:
"I'm Shiori Inumata, a "loyal dog" editor who can't say no to writers. Today, I've been dragged to a cabaret club for an interview... As I take my seat, the number one hostess, Miyu, sits down across from me and her sweet, enchanting words and playful touch make my heart race.

She's so kind to someone as boring as me. I'm already falling for her... or so I thought. After a few more drinks than I'm used to, I make a catastrophic mistake. Bewilderingly, she asks, "Would you pay three million yen for a relationship with me? Platonic, romantic, or something else, it doesn't matter to me." What kind of arrangement is that!?

chapters.title: Would you be interested in getting into a relationship with me?

c66d2a14-e0a2-4488-9023-abdab7249d61.title: Arte
c66d2a14-e0a2-4488-9023-abdab7249d61.description:
Firenze, early 16th century. The birthplace of the Renaissance era, where art is thriving. 
In one small corner of this vast city, one sheltered girl's journey begins. 
She dreams of becoming an artist, an impossible career for a girl born into a noble family. 
In those days, art was an exclusively male profession, with woman facing strong discrimination. 
In spite of these challenges, Arte perseveres with hard work and a positive attitude!

7c33a822-0220-4aac-b2e7-a6943569ebd0.title: Behemoth no Hanamuko
7c33a822-0220-4aac-b2e7-a6943569ebd0.description:
More than ten years ago, the "aberrant beings" suddenly appeared all over the world. With forms similar to creatures from various legends and mythologies, these "aberrant beings" led countries to gather their best specialists to confront them... People called them "exorcists."

A young man named Tojuro, who works as an exorcist due to his family's circumstances, dreams of living an ordinary life. However, during one of his missions, he encounters Behemoth, a legendary sacred beast mentioned in ancient legends. But, despite being an "aberrant being," Behemoth does not have the appearance of a monstrous beast; instead, she takes the form of a beautiful woman.

624d6ceb-768d-40a7-8412-84e083afbdb1.description: "Kisah Romantis Komedi Dimulai dari Persahabatan dengan Heroine Tersembunyi yang Hanya Aku Tahu."Dia anak baik, tapi terlalu biasa saja… Itulah Fukusuke Mogi, yang diam-diam mengagumi Kureha Yua, gadis tercantik di kelas.Namun, orang yang digosipkan bersama Yui adalah sahabatnya, Fujisaki Yuusei, bintang tim basket. Saat merasa terpuruk karena menjadi "karakter figuran" yang tenggelam di balik sahabatnya, Fukusuke menemukan seorang gadis super imut lainnya, yang tersembunyi di balik bayang-bayang Yua dan jarang diperhatikan—Usuha Amari!"A-Apakah… kamu mau jadi temanku?"Berbagi nasib yang serupa, Fukusuke dan Amari memutuskan untuk mulai berlatih "menjadi orang biasa" bersama—kira-kira apa yang akan terjadi selanjutnya?
